orgName: Tour of Guangxi (People's Government of Guangxi / Wanda Group)

source.name: Cyclingnews - Gree-Tour of Guangxi stages (race name in title-sponsor form)
source.note: Cyclingnews uses the hyphenated title 'Gree-Tour of Guangxi 2026' for the WorldTour finale; the race is 'officially known as the GREE-Tour of Guangxi for sponsorship purposes' (Tour of Guangxi race record). A 2022 WorldTour calendar on Cycling Weekly already lists 'Gree-Tour of Guangxi'.

note: Title sponsor - GREE's name is in the official race name. Fee not published. GREE is owned by Gree Group (Zhuhai Municipal Government / Zhuhai SASAC) and already rated concern. Ownership per research: the Tour of Guangxi is owned and organised by the People's Government of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region (provincial-level government body); primary ownership document not yet opened.
